note: The command names that several apps share and that do not mean one thing among them, each let stand with its reason (docs/axKit/command-language.md CL-7.3; the maintainer's decision of 2026-11-25). A name is a command's canonical name in its app, as docs/axKit/window-commands.json gives it; 'differs' is 'mark', 'key' or 'mark and key': the commands' marks differ, or their chords among those that have one. tests/AxAutomate.Tests/CommandMeaningsTests fails on a name that differs and is not here as it differs, and on an entry here that no longer differs: a new difference is made one by a name of its own or added here on purpose, and one made one is taken off. The list was reviewed the day it was made and keeps only what cannot be made one: a Windows standard, a real difference of what a command reaches, or a difference of key, since keys wait on the maintainer's reading of the key families (CL-7.2) and no key is changed for this list. Which family a chord belongs to is not checked here yet.

exceptions.name: Interrupt
exceptions.reason: The same meaning, to interrupt the program the window runs: Shift+Escape in axClaude, Ctrl+Shift+C in axTerminal, where Ctrl+C goes to the shell. Made one only by changing a key, which waits on the key families.

exceptions.name: New window
exceptions.reason: The same meaning. Ctrl+N is New, a new document, in the editors (axDown, axJSON), a Windows standard, so their New window is Ctrl+Shift+N; axFile, axMedia and axPreview have no New and keep Ctrl+N. Made one only by changing a key, which waits on the key families.

exceptions.name: Open
exceptions.reason: Two Windows standards under one word: the editors' Open... (Ctrl+O) asks for a file with the Windows picker, and a list's Open (Enter) opens the row the user is on. axFile's Open starts a file's own program, which reaches outside the window, so it is act (mcp.md MC-D7) where the others are open.

exceptions.name: Open folder
exceptions.reason: The same meaning, a folder opened in the window; axClaude's starts Claude Code again in the folder, which starts a program, so it is act (MC-D7) where axFile's is open. axMedia's, which adds to its queue, is Add folder since 2026-11-25.

exceptions.name: Paste
exceptions.reason: The same meaning, the clipboard's content put where the user is: Ctrl+V in axFile (files into the folder); in axClip it is the list's Enter, its main action, which pastes the chosen entry into the window behind; the editors' Paste is the edit control's own key, given no chord. Made one only by changing a key, which waits on the key families.

exceptions.name: Rename
exceptions.reason: The same meaning; axFile's renames a file or folder of the computer, which other programs may rely on, so it is act, where the item windows' rename an item of the list they hold (change).

exceptions.name: Undo
exceptions.reason: The same meaning; the editors' and the item windows' undo a change of what the window holds (change), axFile's takes back a file operation on the disk, a move, a delete or a rename, so it is act (command-language.md section 8 (c)).
